using MPI, CUDA, JSON3
# UCX caches memory-type lookups. CUDA.jl's pool reuses device addresses,
# so a cached host verdict can be applied to a device pointer and the
# transport faults. Disabling the cache is the documented workaround and
# must be set before MPI.Init.
get(ENV, "UCX_MEMTYPE_CACHE", "") == "" && (ENV["UCX_MEMTYPE_CACHE"] = "n")
MPI.Init()
comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD
rank = MPI.Comm_rank(comm); n = MPI.Comm_size(comm)
lc = MPI.Comm_split_type(comm, MPI.COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0)
CUDA.device!(MPI.Comm_rank(lc) % CUDA.ndevices())
r = Dict{String,Any}("rank"=>rank, "nranks"=>n, "host"=>gethostname())
t(k, f) = try r[k] = f() catch e; r[k] = "ERR: " * first(sprint(showerror, e), 200) end

t("scalar_int_sum",   () -> MPI.Allreduce(rank + 1, +, comm))
t("scalar_int_min",   () -> MPI.Allreduce(rank + 1, min, comm))
t("scalar_f64_sum",   () -> MPI.Allreduce(Float64(rank + 1), +, comm))
t("hostarr_sum",      () -> (b = fill(Float32(rank+1), 4); MPI.Allreduce!(b, +, comm); Array(b)))
t("cuarr_sum",        () -> (b = CUDA.fill(Float32(rank+1), 4); MPI.Allreduce!(b, +, comm); Array(b)))
t("cuarr_len1_sum",   () -> (b = CUDA.fill(Float32(rank+1), 1); MPI.Allreduce!(b, +, comm); Array(b)))
t("cuarr_then_scalar",() -> (b = CUDA.fill(Float32(rank+1), 4); MPI.Allreduce!(b, +, comm);
                             MPI.Allreduce(rank + 1, +, comm)))
if rank == 0
    all = Any[r]
    for s in 1:(n-1); push!(all, MPI.recv(comm; source=s, tag=3)); end
    println(JSON3.write(Dict("probe"=>all)))
end
if rank != 0
    MPI.send(r, comm; dest=0, tag=3)
end
flush(stdout); flush(stderr)
MPI.Barrier(comm)
try MPI.Finalize() catch e; println(stderr, "Finalize: ", sprint(showerror, e)) end
exit(0)
